findings.title: Rates below the Crestline most-favoured-customer rate card (§6.4)
findings.explanation: Potential conflict — not a breach determination. Crestline Retail Inc §6.4 is a most-favoured (MFN) pricing promise: rates no less favourable than those offered by AtliQ Inc or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services, until 31 Jul 2027. This contract's rate card is lower: Senior Data Engineer $72 vs $85 (−$13/hr); Data Engineer $55 vs $62 (−$7/hr); BI Developer $50 vs $58 (−$8/hr). If these are 'substantially similar services', Crestline's rates drop retroactively to the lower rate and AtliQ owes a credit for every hour billed since the lower rate was offered, plus an audit right (§6.5). In 2024 the clause was accepted as 'harmless — we never discount'.

evidence.quote: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.
